profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Walmart Media Group
profile.summary: Currently a backend developer helping build a large scale ad platform leveraging genAI and agentic workflows, but I've worked on a variety of software and hardware projects ranging from handmade wireless scales and custom keyboards to fiber optic transceivers.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Large scale genAI system development- agentic workflows using langgraph, langchain, and other frameworks in conjunction with MCP servers for various resources. Maintaining observability infrastructure such as Langfuse and Jaeger. Building offline classifier pipelines in airflow. Deploying fine tuned models for inference and RAG using Nvidia Triton.

positions.title: senior backend developer
positions.description: Individual contributor on a small team building a high throughput ad network. Automating deployment using Docker and ansible. Tuning Rabbitmq for high performance. Enhancing microservices written in python, and go. Optimizing access to data in AWS Redshift, cassandra, scylladb, postgres, timescaledb, kairosdb. Building OLAP flows with Kafka and Druid. Enhancing system observability with distributed tracing- initially with zipkin and now with jaeger. Ensuring ad campaign deliverability by lowering end to end latency.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Projects that mix signal processing and machine learning. Experience with pandas, scikit-learn,numpy, libsvm, matlab. Infrastructure work including setting up distributed crawlers to gather training data, exposing models via endpoints for client use.

positions.title: web developer
positions.description: Backend web development, primarily in python using flask as well as occasional bits of php. Platforms in use include Heroku and AWS(EC2,S3,Redshift, DynamoDB). Datastore experience: postgres, mongo, redis. Ecommerce platforms experience: woocommerce, shopify.

positions.title: Member of technical staff
positions.description: Speech data analysis in python. Optical signal modeling with Matlab and RSoft. System performance tests with awk, expect, python, and TCL. Digital receiver design including DSP development in Matlab and C implementation on TI C64x. Board bring-up and test.

positions.title: Field Applications Engineer
positions.description: Support of customer design-in for CMOS image sensors and fiber optic transceivers. QA test development for RF power amplifiers and FBAR filters. Technical presentations for iSuppli and EETimes. FCC EMI compliance testing and corrective design proposals.
